result.summary: Persists and reuses heap storage across blocks in CoinsViewOverlay during parallel prevout prefetching. It keeps the intra-block transaction ID hash set and worker task vector alive across blocks, skips inserting the final transaction ID into the filter, and caps dispatched worker tasks to the queued input count while skipping condition variable notification on empty task lists.
result.problem: CoinsViewOverlay::StartFetching reallocates and reseeds an unordered_set of transaction IDs and reallocates a task vector for every block connected. It also inserts the block's final transaction ID even though no subsequent transaction can spend it, and it schedules more worker tasks than available inputs when input queues are small.
evidence: No benchmark numbers or profiling traces are included in the PR description or commit messages to substantiate the performance impact of these allocation savings.
result.changed_since_previous: Replaced the previous modification of ThreadPool::Submit parameter types with moving the persistent task vector directly, and added a check in ThreadPool::Submit to skip condition variable notification when the submitted futures list is empty.
result.card: Reduces per-block allocation overhead in CoinsViewOverlay during parallel prevout prefetching. It reuses the intra-block transaction ID filter and worker task vector across blocks, omits the block's final transaction ID from the filter, and caps worker tasks to the queued input count. No performance benchmarks are provided to measure the impact of the avoided allocations.

risk.why: A mistake in tracking earlier intra-block transaction IDs or prefetch task execution could lead to missing or incorrect prevout prefetching during block connection.
